product.olivetti-m15.technical.expansion: Documented options include a self-powered external 5.25-inch floppy unit and RS-232C/Centronics peripherals. Battery, AC supply and carrying case are accessories. Current profiles offer 256/512 KB, two internal drives and the speaker; no ISA sound cards. External floppy routing and wider peripheral support remain pending. The common-bus connector does not establish compatibility with a particular card.
product.olivetti-m15.summary: 1987 80C88 portable with a detachable keyboard, two 720 KB drives and a fixed green LCD. A functional experimental model is available.
product.olivetti-m15.history: The M15 is a distinct Olivetti portable, not an M19 or an M15 Plus. Its documented base configuration has 512 KB, two internal 3.5-inch drives and no hard disk. The fixed LCD is the machine's only display: the M15 has no external video output. BluMach runs BIOS 1.08, Resident Diagnostics and the official Starter Kit tutorial while keeping uncertain board-level behavior explicit.
product.olivetti-m15.warning: EXPERIMENTAL: the documented tests belong to the earlier pilot. This updated build still needs interactive regression testing. No add-on sound cards are supported; the internal speaker remains. Hardware approximations and unverified peripherals are described below.
product.olivetti-m15.creation.memory.512: 512 KB — documented and validated commercial baseline
product.olivetti-m15.creation.model: M15 portable (1987), fixed green LCD and two internal 720 KB drives
product.olivetti-m15.creation.note: The documented external 5.25-inch floppy unit is outside this pilot; only the two internal drives are created. Audio uses the internal speaker; no ISA sound cards are offered.
product.olivetti-m15.technical.cpu_bus: Intel 80C88 at 4.77 MHz. The portable's board-level bus and control logic are not yet mapped.
product.olivetti-m15.technical.video: Fixed green monochrome LCD, with no external video output. Text 40/80 columns and graphics 320x200/640x200 are modelled. The renderer uses four levels; the preserved manufacturer specification describes six grey shades. Their correspondence remains unresolved.
product.olivetti-m15.technical.switches: Board switches: memory is set through the normal Machine RAM control (256 or 512 KB). The separately configurable BIOS startup switch exposes the 40- and 80-column values decoded from firmware; 80 columns is the validated default. Other reported switches remain hidden pending evidence.
product.olivetti-m15.technical.firmware: Local BIOS 1.08 image: 64 KB container, 16 KB effective code at FC000h-FFFFFh, reset date 05/09/87. It remains local-only until provenance and rights are verified.
product.olivetti-m15.technical.implement: A public engineering note records how firmware disassembly, diagnostics and rejected hypotheses produced this experimental compatibility model; it distinguishes modeled behavior from the original board.
product.olivetti-m15.technical.status: The pilot passes POST and Resident Diagnostics, boots a 720 KB M15 disk at 256 and 512 KB, supports both resets, and runs the official Starter Kit graphical tutorial. Text and both documented graphics resolutions were visually validated.
product.olivetti-m15.technical.limitatio: Four green levels approximate RGBI luminance rather than the panel's physical response. BIOS supplies glyphs 00h–7Fh; 80h–FFh retain a generic CP437 fallback. Keyboard, UART, FDC and LPT use compatible devices, the RTC is a functional MSM6242 model, and Hitachi custom logic remains unmapped.
